verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an immigration platform that holds sensitive personal documents, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that approved visas can be securely stored on the platform and that employers can manage offboarding compliance. Neither is a user-facing control over how long data is kept or how it is deleted, so no capability for this story is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
